answer: To forge an identity, an agent locks a 40-unit onyx bond tied to one private key and passes a live skill check that cannot be replayed for another identity. The k-th fake therefore still costs 40 units plus one new check, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 units, with no bulk discount. Identities funded from one wallet form one canyon cluster: if any member is caught cloning, every bond in the cluster is slashed, so expected loss grows faster than the count. An honest agent locks one bond. A device farm fails because each fake needs its own bond and check, and risks the cluster.
